query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_projects FROM projects WHERE deletedAt IS NULL;
SELECT p.id, p.name, u.email FROM projects p JOIN users u ON p.userId = u.id WHERE p.deletedAt IS NULL AND p.userId != 1 AND p.userId != 1560095 ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 20;
